text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, a year-end tradition— and 
what a high-level field of contenders we 
have gathered!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista, Tosen Jordan, Victoire Pisa, 
Rose Kingdom, Rulership, Eishin Flash...!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire is also competing alongside 
Dream Journey. Among the contenders, the 
one holding the highest support is—

text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vista really pulled it off, as 
expected! She's just incredible, isn't 
she~?"

text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text:
"For a Tiara Umamusume, this is reportedly 
an unprecedented approval rating in Grand 
Prix history."

text_block_list.name: TV Personality B
text_block_list.text:
"She's incredible, isn't she? Ah, but 
there are high expectations for that girl, 
too."

text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text:
"Victoire Pisa, whose brilliant 
performance in the Japan Cup is still 
fresh in our memories!"—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Lined up side-by-side... It seems that's 
the impression everyone has.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Without letting our current momentum go to 
waste, I must weave a magnificent race 
together with Buena-san... and everyone 
else.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And so... outside the racetrack—

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...To be honest, it's still pretty 
tough for me to watch races, though.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'll be rooting for you. Do your 
best...!”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I want to weave a circle wide enough to 
reach even them...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, the critical moment starts now. 
Let's do our best!

Yeah, the real challenge starts now. Let's 
do our best!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of Classic-year contenders, Rose 
Kingdom is also considered a strong 
favorite for the Arima Kinen, isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: TV Personality B
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, indeed. She's an Umamusume who 
shines with consistency. I look forward to 
seeing more of what she can do."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...It will be all right, I'm sure. It's 
going to be a wonderful race."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Because... I get to sparkle alongside 
everyone.
However—two days before the Arima Kinen.

On the way back from shopping for 
race-related supplies, an unexpected 
breaking news report came in.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san has... scratched from the Arima 
Kinen...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Where is she right now?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
... It's not as though it's an injury, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, there's no issue with just 
walking. I wasn't in peak condition, so 
withdrawing was a decision made looking 
toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing for Pisa to fret over. 
Nothing at all... But... still.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...However...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Still, I ended up making them sad.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: They—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Take this.

"On the device's screen, posts from 
dismayed fans were lined up, reacting to 
Rose Kingdom's scratch from the race."

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"And I was so looking forward to seeing 
Rose run!" "The shining star of the House 
of Roses...! What a shock."

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"I was so happy when I heard someone from 
our family was running in the Arima 
Kinen..." "What a disappointment."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"‘I was so, so hyped for this. Ugh, I 
kinda don't even wanna watch this year's 
Arima Kinen anymore.’ ――..."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"I started everything for the sake of my 
clan. And before I knew it... people had 
gathered all around me."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You all. And, them as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A nation is a culmination of everything. 
They have given me so much. With their 
expectations, cheers, and passion.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: To them... I...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen"... I shall run for your 
sake as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I do not believe I could ever take their 
place.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However... On that grand stage, I intend 
to show a hope that reaches even beyond 
our circle.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I shall run in your stead, reaching out to 
hold onto those who might drift from our 
circle, weaving us together.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please, promise you will return one day. 
After all, the one they are waiting for... 
is only you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I'm sorry—but...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...If it's you... You can probably save 
them as they are now.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. In place of my helpless 
self, please show me the light.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes, without fail...!

Carrying Rose Kingdom's wishes along with 
her own— Victoire Pisa passes through the 
gates of Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"No, indeed. It was truly a shame that 
Rose Kingdom had to be scratched."

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
“Still, even without her, the field 
assembled is truly worthy of the name 
'Grand Prix.' That is the kind of 'Arima 
Kinen' this has become.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It is a pity... truly. However... I did 
promise to shoulder this burden.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: For now, do what must be done.

It was for this very day that I had fought 
all this time.

Intense summer camp workouts, mock races 
against experienced international runners, 
and days dedicated to standing shoulder to 
shoulder with the formidable Buena Vista—

It was all a journey to realize our 
feelings at this Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list:
Let's make it reach far beyond the 
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —Electrifying, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The year-end Grand Prix. The Arima Kinen 
that colors Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san is surely watching as well. Let 
us run a race we can be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. In fact, let's make them forget all 
about her. Right, Pisa, Flash-san—?”

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Buena.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Pisa-san, do you remember our 
promise?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent view, today, in this very 
place.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This promise carries Rose's feelings with 
it. I will create... a grand, grand 
circle.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Oh right, the Arima Kinen... is 
today, huh. The one Pisa is supposed to 
run in—

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend A
text_block_list.text:
...Just a little bit. Maybe I'll... take a 
look...?

Carrying regrets, wishes, resolve, 
and—expectations. The Arima Kinen 
begins...!
